PLAHIS Planning Application Reference: DM2026/00414 - Address: 46 Link LaneWallingtonSM6 9DZ - Proposal: Application to vary condition 1 (Approved Plans) of planning permission Ref: DM2023/01355 for the 'Demolition of existing two-storey side extension and erection of a  two-storey detached dwelling with roof accommodation, including a rear dormer and rooflights to the front roofslope. Extension of the existing dropped kerb and alterations to the front boundary wall, provision of parking at the front and refuse and cycle storage, and installation of Air Source Heat Pump' to allow for a two storey front extension (widening of bay window), extension to dormer, increase to loft floor space, formation of a front entrance porch, provision of additional rooflights to front and rear roofslopes and alteration of render and fenestrations. - Status: GTD - Decision: GTD - Date Decision Issued: 21-MAY-26

LGW Coloured Squares (Height Triggers) for IFP Safeguarded area: Please consult London Gatwick on the following: All buildings, structures & works exceeding 150 m AGL.

LGW Extent of IFP (Instrument Flight Procedures Safeguarded Area): Please consult London Gatwick on the following:All other applications connected with an aviation use, for example:Development at an existing aerodrome. Creation of a new aerodrome. The use of a site for the purpose of flight or as a drop zone for parachuting. Note: For further information see citcular 01/2003 (ODPM, DfT).
LGW Wind Turbine Circle: Please consult London Gatwick on the following:Any planning applications that include proposals for wind turbines, within 30km of the aerodrome.
